dhp116:2: ward off the mind from wickedness,
dhp116:4: for the mind of the one slow in merit delights in wickedness.
dhp117:1: Should a person do that which is wicked,
dhp117:2: he should not do it again and again,
dhp117:3: let him not place his intention in it,
dhp117:4: (for) there is an accumulation of suffering for the wicked one.
dhp118:1: If a person should make merit,
dhp118:2: he should do it again and again,
dhp118:3: let him place his intention there, there is an increase of joy for the one who has made merit.
dhp119:1: Even the wicked one experiences good fortune while the wickedness does not ripen,
dhp119:3: but when the wickedness ripens then the wicked one experiences wicked things.
dhp120:1: Even the fortunate one experiences wickedness as long as the good fortune does not ripen,
dhp120:3: but when the fortune ripens then the fortunate one experiences good fortune.
dhp121:1: One should not despise a little wickedness (thinking):
dhp121:2: it will not come to me,
dhp121:3: through the falling of water drops the water-pot is (quickly) filled,
dhp121:5: the fool, gathering bit by bit,
dhp122:1: One should not despise a little merit (thinking): it will not come to me,
dhp122:3: through the falling of water drops the water-pot is (quickly) filled,
dhp122:5: the wise one, gathering bit by bit, becomes full of merit.
dhp123:1: Like a merchant on a fearful path,
dhp123:2: with few friends and great wealth,
dhp123:3: as one loving life (would avoid) poison,
dhp124:1: If there is no wound in his hand he can carry poison with his hand,
dhp124:3: poison does not enter without a wound,
dhp124:4: there is no bad result for the one who does no (wrong).
dhp125:1: One offends against the inoffensive one,
dhp125:3: that wicked deed (then) returns to the fool,
dhp125:4: like fine dust that is thrown against the wind.
dhp126:1: Some are reborn in the womb,
dhp126:2: (but) those who are wicked in the underworld,
dhp126:4: those who are pollutant-free are emancipated.
dhp127:1: Neither in the sky, nor in the middle of the ocean,
dhp127:2: nor after entering a mountain cleft:
dhp127:3: there is no place found on this earth
dhp127:4: where one can be free from (the results of) wicked deeds.
dhp128:1: Neither in the sky, nor in the middle of the ocean,
dhp128:2: nor after entering a mountain cleft:
dhp128:3: there is no place found on this earth,
dhp128:4: in which death does not overcome one.
